question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**alterations**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses how global warming impacts rainfall and plant distribution.
 
• The suitable word should indicate changes or variations in rainfall and plant distribution due to global warming.
 
• "**Alterations**" is appropriate as it denotes changes or modifications, fitting the context.
 
• Other options ("**stabilisation**", "**stagnation**", "**fixation**") do not fit the context of describing the changes in rainfall and plant distribution.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
